c74object.name: lp.poppy~
c74object.description: lp.poppy~ uses the logistic population model as a signal generator: new values are computed at a base frequency and interpolated. The 4th inlet sets the interpolation: -1 geometric (default), 0 none, 1 linear, 2 quadratic. A population that has died out (growth rate below 1) starts again at the seed as soon as the growth rate is above 1, and values that run away (e.g. a growth signal above 4) start again at the seed (since 2026); reset or a new seed restarts it at once.

objarg.name: baseFreq
objarg.digest: Base frequency in Hz (default 0 = the sample rate)

method.name: float
method.description: In the left inlet: Growth Rate. In the 2nd inlet: Seed population. In the 3rd inlet: Base Frequency.

method.name: reset
method.digest: Start again at the seed population
method.description: Start again at the seed population.

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).
